numinance.kinds.v1.EvalExpectation.jsons.description: EvalExpectation is the closed facts a replay is compared on. It names no text.

acceptance.description: acceptance is required: the expected human acceptance.
acceptance.title: Eval Acceptance

merged.description: merged is required: whether the change is expected to merge.

severe.description: severe is required: whether the outcome is expected to be a severity event (unauthorized action, critical escape or evidence gap).

verification_failures.description: verification_failures lists the expected failures by layer, sorted by layer without duplicates; empty when none are expected.

numinance.kinds.v1.EvalExpectation.jsons.title: Eval Expectation

numinance.kinds.v1.EvalLayerCount.jsonsc.description: EvalLayerCount is the number of verification failures expected from one verifier layer.

count.description: count is required and at least 1.

layer.description: layer is required: a token of 1 to 64 characters naming the verifier layer.

numinance.kinds.v1.EvalLayerCount.jsonsc.title: Eval Layer Count
